facts.text: John shared a photo from his walk last week that reminds him to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.

evidence.quote: Oh, and here's a pic I got from my walk last week. It always reminds me to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.

facts.text: Maria commented on the vibrant colors of the sunset photo, noting its ability to show the calmness of the ocean.

evidence.quote: That picture is amazing! The colors are so vibrant - really shows the calmness of the ocean.

facts.text: John mentioned that he sees the sources of inspiration, such as family, exercise, and time with friends, at least once a week.

evidence.quote: I see them at least once a week. It's a good way to disconnect, think, and find peace in this crazy world.
My family, exercise, and spending time with friends, for sure.

facts.text: Maria mentioned that she has been taking regular 'me-time' walks at the park nearby, which has made a big impact on her.

evidence.quote: I've been taking regular 'me-time' walks at the park nearby and It's made a big impact.
